manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball rising and falling alongside its velocity-time graph to demonstrate that gravity's force and acceleration remain constant even when vertical velocity reaches zero at the peak.
manifest.description: Left: A vertical ruler (0 to 2.2 m) showing the height of a tossed ball, with velocity and acceleration vectors alongside live values for velocity, acceleration, and gravitational force. Right: A velocity-time plot from 0 to 1.8 s with a line of constant negative slope -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare the readings at each pause near the top. Change mass while paused to compare force and acceleration.
